name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/are/simulation/validation/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.resolve_arg_placeholders: resolve argument placeholders in a CompletedEvent by replacing them with return values from past target events
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_event_filter: create an EventFilter subclass to preprocess and filter CompletedEvent objects based on custom criteria
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.filter_agent_events: filter agent events using AgentEventFilter to keep only non-failed write action events
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.filter_env_agent_events: filter environment and agent events using EnvAgentEventFilter to keep non-failed env user and write agent events
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.describe_event_bullet: describe a CompletedEvent using BulletEventDescription to generate a formatted string with tool name time and arguments

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_llm_checkers: build LLM checkers for content, email, message, event, tone, cab, sanity, and signature validation
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_subtask_extractor: build an LLM subtask extractor for calendar events or user message tools
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_LLMFunction: create an LLMFunction that constructs system and user prompts with examples then calls the engine
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_LLMChecker: create an LLMChecker that evaluates prompts via majority voting across multiple LLM calls
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_LLMFunctionBase: review the LLMFunctionBase abstract class that defines the interface for LLM interaction

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.extract_text_between_tags: extract text content from all occurrences of a specified HTML tag using BeautifulSoup
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.normalize_str: normalize a string by converting to lowercase and removing accents and punctuation
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.normalize_arg: normalize an argument by converting it to a string and removing accents and punctuation
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_extract_text_between_tags: review the extract_text_between_tags function to parse HTML and return text from matching tags
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.test_normalize_str: test the normalize_str function with accented and punctuated input strings

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.extract_tasks: extract tasks from a scenario by filtering oracle run event log for agent user interface messages
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.extract_user_details: extract user contact details from a scenario contacts app and return the user contact object
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.extract_agent_events: extract and filter agent events from an environment event log sorted by time and turn index
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.topological_sort: perform topological sort on a graph dictionary of event IDs and their parent dependencies
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_oracle_mode: run a scenario in oracle mode using an environment and attach the oracle run event log

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_injected_traceable_decorator: create a decorator that traces class methods by dynamically fetching a tracer from the instance
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.use_injected_traceable_with_tags: use the injected_traceable decorator with custom tags to label traced method calls
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.use_injected_traceable_with_trace_type: use the injected_traceable decorator with a trace_type parameter to specify the trace kind
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.use_injected_traceable_with_metadata: use the injected_traceable decorator with meta_data to attach additional context to traces
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_injected_traceable_fallback: review the injected_traceable decorator fallback behavior when no tracer attribute is found on the instance
